results.title: KMJS' Gabi Ng Lagim: The Movie
results.original_title: KMJS' Gabi Ng Lagim: The Movie
results.overview: Three chilling tales based on real stories expose the haunting depths of faith, fear, and the unknown — from a seafarer trapped on a cursed voyage, to an island plagued by a flesh-eating legend, and a young woman's battle against a legion of demons that pushes the limits of faith and sanity.

results.title: Stings
results.overview: Immersed in the vibrant tapestry of Taipei, Yu Wen and Xiao's paths intersect. While Xiao is poised to move on, Yu Wen is ready to confront his past, only to find himself slipping back into the comfort of the status quo. A poetic vignette of Taiwan, its people and their resilience.

results.title: Hari Hara Veera Mallu: Part 1 – Sword vs Spirit
results.original_title: హరి హర వీర మల్లు: భాగం 1 – Sword vs Spirit
results.overview: Set in the 1650s Mughal Era, Veera Mallu, a Robin Hood-like outlaw with secret motives is hired to steal the Koh-i-Noor from Aurangzeb’s palace. He is joined by a crew of misfits, each talented in their own way, to complete the mission.

results.title: Starting Quarterback
results.overview: Two former high school quarterbacks are reunited and forced to work together to stop a drug cartel.

results.title: Metta
results.overview: Elira, Chiara, and Diego, three young people already intertwined in the past, embark on a three-way love affair. Despite their differing perspectives on commitment, intimacy, and relationships, the love between them is undeniable. During a night together in Madrid, their disagreements surface, turning their encounter into a struggle between harmony and fear.

results.title: Mystic Springs
results.overview: A grief-stricken detective investigates a ritualistic crime in a quiet Midwestern town, uncovering a shadowy cult that blurs the line between faith and reality—and threatens to consume him entirely.

results.title: Tidings for the Season
results.overview: A local newscaster’s life changes when he meets a 10-year-old fan — and his single mother — during the holidays.

results.title: Algiers
results.overview: The kidnapping of a little girl creates tension and suspicion in Algiers. Only Dounia, a brilliant psychiatrist, and Sami, a police inspector, can unearth the demons of the past.

results.original_title: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling - Mayhem Night 2
results.overview: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling - Mayhem Night 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling. It took place on March 15, 2025, in Windsor, Ontario, Canada, at the St. Clair College.

results.title: Pokémon: Dragonite and the Special Delivery
results.original_title: カイリューとゆうびんやさん
results.overview: Hana dreams of becoming an ace mail carrier, just like her hero, Dragonite. Upon finding a letter with no address, she journeys with her partner Pokémon, Fuecoco, to locate the sender. Will Hana and Fuecoco find the mystery sender and get the letter to its destination?

results.title: The Baltimorons
results.overview: A newly sober man's Christmas Eve dental emergency leads to an unexpected romance with his older dentist as they explore Baltimore together.

results.title: Mortal Game
results.overview: A group of hunters travel to a mysterious island to track down a legendary forest creature. They soon realize their guide has set them up as bait, forcing them to confront a highly intelligent predator that terrorizes them one by one.

results.title: Miraculous Accident
results.overview: Moroccan student Nadir arrives at Łódź Film School in 1968, amidst Eastern anti-imperialist support. He meets Jewish teacher Edyta, who is forced to leave Poland after the Six-Day War. In 2024 he finds her letter, reviving memories of a fractured love.

results.title: Szypliszki
results.overview: Sam, a middle-aged romantic en route to a Polish village to meet his perfect match, spends an overnight layover in Queens with his niece and her girlfriend whose relationship is on its last legs.

results.title: Caleb Hearon: Model Comedian
results.overview: ​In his debut stand-up special, actor, comedian, writer, and podcaster Caleb Hearon takes us back to his roots in Kansas City...where it all started. Newly 30, Hearon deploys his generational Midwestern wisdom to solve most of the world's problems: politics, internet trolls, learning we're not that different from our parents, and more.

results.title: Mother Bhumi
results.overview: In a community of farmers living on the Malaysia-Thailand border, Hong Im recently lost her husband under mysterious circumstances. Hong Im uses black magic to address villagers’ everyday issues until she encounters a ghost that reveals a secret about her husband’s death.

results.title: E
results.overview: Ex prime Minister Eva Vogler causes a scandal at the Nobel Banquet and soon ﬁnds herself lost in the desert of the real. There she is confronted by her doppelgänger and other characters, one of them a possessed man pretending to be her husband. Throughout the ﬁlm voice messages are being left on Vogler’s answering machine, suggesting reasons leading to the scandal. The doppelgängers pose a danger for all the lost souls wandering in the desert, since they seek to destroy the original and move forward to a metaverse free of human suﬀering.

results.title: Marginalia
results.overview: Summoned to Karnstein Abbey to serve as a mourner at the funeral of their recently deceased abbess, Sister Trista discovers a dark secret involving demons, witchcraft and killer rabbits. But Sister Trista has a secret of her own.

results.title: Koko Suzanne
results.overview: Based on true events, a young girl's life is turned upside down when her grandmother's strange behaviour sparks fears of witchcraft. As her family struggles to reconcile illness with the supernatural, she must navigate the streets of Kinshasa in order to protect the grandmother she knows and loves.
